_comment: Copy to tests/bench/prices.json (gitignored), fill in per-million-token prices from https://aws.amazon.com/bedrock/pricing/ (or the OpenAI pricing page for OPENAI_DIRECT) on the day you read them, and point BENCH_PRICES_FILE at it. Keys are model slot names from tests/bench/config.py. A slot with no entry is treated as unpriced: its runs show cost n/a and count against --max-cost as unknown.
